note: The glue over all fourteen catch kinds: item cells and anchors, fill rules, heap rule, hold. Tables and per-kind results read from CatchKit2 at generation; the item variant -> pose mapping is transcribed from item().

dense._note: DENSE kinds add jittered extras per slot so a tote of herring reads as ninety herring, not eight fish in a box

item.call: item(kind, {variant 0..3, scale, spoil}) -> {canvas, w, h, ax, ay}
item.anchor: ax, ay = the ground anchor in the item canvas; draw at slot - anchor

fish.bake: rest deck, frame = variant % 4, heading = [E, W, SE, SW][variant % 4]

crustacean.bake: pose walk, frame = variant % 4, ang = [0.4, 2.2, 3.7, 5.3][variant % 4] rad

shellfish.bake: renderItem(kind, variant % 4, scale), spoil via tintSpoil

fillItems.call: fillItems(catch, fill, seed, slotCount) -> [{kind, variant, scale, jx, jy}]
fillItems.monotonic: seeded — growing a fill never moves earlier items; pass the container's real slot count so full / brim genuinely heap
fillItems.scale: clamp(0.85 + rng x 0.30, SPECIES.range) — fish take their species range, everything else [0.85, 1.15]
fillItems.jitter: extras beyond count / DENSE get jx in [-3, 3], jy in [-2, 2] px
fillItems.mixed: kind drawn per item from [herring, mackerel, haddock, lobster, crab, pollock, cod, bass, flounder]

heap.call: heap(kind, rimPoly [{dx,dy}], depthPx, fill, seed, {spoil}) -> {canvas, x, y} | null (empty)
heap.rule: surface lowered by (1 - min(1, FRAC[fill] / 0.85)) x depthPx; brim crowns 2 px above the rim as a dome; ramp steps darken down-right, lift up-left

hold.rule: fish -> FishIso2.hold, crustaceans -> Crustacean2.hold, shellfish -> {mass: SIZES.mass x 7 x scale, hands: 1, handful: true}

spoil.rule: per pixel, mix toward SPOIL by spoil x (0.40 + 0.28 where Bayer(x,y) < spoil x 0.55); the keyline colour is exempt
spoil.motes: runtime FX in SPOIL — CatchKit2.particles(seed, n)
spoil.tintSpoil: tintSpoil(rgba, w, h, spoil) — skips pixels with r + g + b < 70 (the keyline / eye darks)
spoil.particles: particles(seed, n) -> [{ox, oy, phase, speed}] mote specs, drawn in SPOIL with alpha (1 - cycle) x 0.5 x spoil
